title: purchase (page to native)
description: Opens the Google Play purchase sheet. With oldPurchaseToken, the purchase replaces an existing subscription (plan change).

basePlanId.description: Google Play base plan id, or null for the product's only base plan.

obfuscatedAccountId.description: Pass unchanged to BillingFlowParams.Builder.setObfuscatedAccountId. Generated by the server; never derive it on the device.

oldPurchaseToken.description: Purchase token of the subscription being replaced (SubscriptionUpdateParams.Builder.setOldPurchaseToken).

replacementMode.description: SubscriptionUpdateParams.ReplacementMode, chosen by the server and passed through.

metadata.description: Added by @hotwired/hotwire-native-bridge to every message sent by the page.
